text:
jess: Anyone up for a 'Console Curator' LAN at the office this Friday? Thinking Switch + some Steam couch co-op. I can bring a dock and a spare USB-C cable. Vote below :v:

mike: I'm in — bringing my Switch OLED + Smash. Also have a USB-C ethernet adapter.

sam: I'll bring a tiny LAN laptop and a couple of Steam keys (Dead Cells, Hades). Can host local lobbies.

lina: down but can only show up after 7pm. I'll bring snacks. Anyone have an extra Pro controller? @mike

nora: I can bring a Pro controller and napkins. Mario Kart tourney? :trophy:

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled network maintenance Friday 6:00-7:00pm may affect online play. See https://status.redwood.example/maintenance

jess: Good catch — let's shift start to 7:30pm to be safe. @sam can you host offline lobbies?

sam: Yup I can host offline lobbies and a local Steam share. I'll bring a 1Gb switch + power strip. Quick checklist:
```
- dock + HDMI
- ethernet adapter
- controllers (2+)
- power strip
- snacks
```

mike: Also let's have a controller swap table for cables/adapters. I have a wired GameCube adapter.

lina: Re: snacks — salsa or guac? :drooling_face:

nora: :thumbsup: guac. I'll bring some and napkins.

jess: Awesome. Confirmed so far: jess, mike, sam, lina, nora. If you're in drop a :shipit:

mike: :shipit:

sam: :shipit: Also posted a quick poll for final timing https://poll.example/lan-start

lina: :shipit: See you Friday 7:30pm in the 4th-floor lounge.

nora: Plot twist: my dock has a tiny cat sticker. Bringing extra stickers for bragging rights :cat2:
